Container.Name: SortDVR
Container.Overview:
SortDVR classifies each finished Dispatcharr DVR recording as TV, Movie, or Sport and moves it to the right folder — Plex-format for TV/Movie (Plex finishes from the name) and a raw broadcaster-tagged handoff for Sport into SpoilerFreePlexSports' watch folder. It uses the Dispatcharr API as the source of truth (waits for the recording to complete and Comskip to finish before touching a file).
IMPORTANT: The "Recordings" path MUST point at the same share Dispatcharr records into, mounted at /data/recordings (the path the API reports in file_path). SortDVR starts in DRY-RUN — it logs the moves it WOULD make and touches nothing. Watch the logs, and only then set "Actually move files" to true.
Container.Requires: A running Dispatcharr instance with an API key, and (for Sport) SpoilerFreePlexSports.

Config.Name: Recordings (source)
Config.Description: MUST match Dispatcharr's recordings share — the path its API reports in file_path. Files are MOVED out of here.

Config.Name: TV destination
Config.Description: Where TV episodes are moved (Plex TV library).

Config.Name: Movie destination
Config.Description: Where movies are moved (Plex movie library).

Config.Name: Sport destination
Config.Description: The SAME folder SpoilerFreePlexSports watches (its /watch). Sport is dropped here for it to identify. MUST be a dedicated sport folder — do NOT point this at the recordings source, or SpoilerFree will also see TV/movies.

Config.Name: Dispatcharr URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Dispatcharr instance.

Config.Name: Dispatcharr API key
Config.Description: Generate in Dispatcharr (POST /api/accounts/api-keys/generate/). Sent as X-API-Key.

Config.Name: Actually move files (GO)
Config.Description: false = DRY-RUN (log only, move nothing). Set true once the dry-run logs look correct.

Config.Name: Second-pass provider
Config.Description: none | groq | gemini — LLM used only for ambiguous cases and movie title/year cleanup.

Config.Name: LLM API key
Config.Description: Required only if a second-pass provider is set.

Config.Name: Comskip enabled
Config.Description: true if Dispatcharr runs Comskip — SortDVR then waits for Comskip to finish before moving.

Config.Name: Poll interval (s)
Config.Description: How often to poll the Dispatcharr API.
